pub async fn accept_candidate(
    data_dir: &Path,
    provider: SubscriptionProvider,
    document: &str,
    token_url_override: Option<&str>,
    catalog_base_url_override: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<AcceptedCredential, AcceptanceFailure> {
    accept_candidate_with_timeout(
        data_dir,
        provider,
        document,
        token_url_override,
        catalog_base_url_override,
        ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT,
    )
    .await
}

pub async fn accept_candidate_with_timeout(
    data_dir: &Path,
    provider: SubscriptionProvider,
    document: &str,
    token_url_override: Option<&str>,
    catalog_base_url_override: Option<&str>,
    timeout: Duration,
) -> Result<AcceptedCredential, AcceptanceFailure> {
    accept_candidate_with_timeout_mode(
        data_dir,
        provider,
        document,
        token_url_override,
        catalog_base_url_override,
        CandidateValidation {
            timeout,
            rotate_candidate: true,
            client: None,
        },
    )
    .await
}
